my company gives me 5 lakh group cover, so why would I pay extra

Employer-provided cover stays in the employer's group policy, which means you can only shift it to your own name when you exit the group. Also, moving from group cover to your own policy may be subject to underwriting, according to IRDAI's circular. Does that change how you view the need for a personal policy?
